# Woteq

> > Woteq provides practical Windows utilities and web-based conversion tools, including Battery Alert Pro for laptop battery management and an ICO converter for multi-resolution icon generation.

Woteq develops software solutions focused on system utilities and media conversion tools. The site offers both downloadable Windows applications built with Microsoft .NET and browser-based conversion utilities for developers and designers.

## Key Topics

- Battery Alert Pro
- Windows 11
- Windows 10
- battery management
- overcharge protection
- laptop battery health
- ICO converter
- image conversion
- multi-resolution icons
- icon generator
- system tray applications
- Microsoft .NET Desktop Runtime
- Windows utilities

## Windows Utilities

- [Battery Alert Pro - Smart Battery Management for Windows](https://woteq.com/batteryalertpro/): Windows battery management utility with overcharge protection alerts

## Image & Icon Tools

- [ICO Converter](https://woteq.com/convert-image-to-ico/): Online tool to convert images to ICO format with multi-resolution support
